{{Quote|They said it would be easy to wash away the memories of battle on a watery world. I guess they never saw an entire ocean run red.|Rin Mako|<ref name="Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref>}}
'''Rin Mako''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the war between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], he fought in a [[Battle of Glee Anselm|battle]] against the Separatists. He regretted the great losses among his people, saying that after the battle, it was not easy to suppress the memories of the battle, because so many died that parts of the seas of Glee Anselm became red with the blood of the fallen.
